svg.title: Nipper Cliffs — Three nipper terraces
svg.desc: Three wide cliff courts create distinct patrol pockets. Rescue ladders and survey scaffolds avoid narrow pinning points; the anchor tent sits outside the upper patrol. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Three wide cliff courts create distinct patrol pockets. Rescue ladders and survey
scaffolds avoid narrow pinning points; the anchor tent sits outside the upper patrol.
7 raised landings · 2 stairs · 3 ropes · 2 ladders · 24 props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
Encounter: Coral Nipper · Hostile / Common; optional local encounter.
